# spec: docs/SPEC.md
# spec: README.md
#
# Every absolute promise in docs/SPEC.md and README.md: a sentence saying "never", "always",
# "refuses", "must not", "deterministic" or "hard error". TestSpecPromisesArePinned
# fails when
#   - a SPEC sentence using one of those words contains none of the quotes below
#     (a new promise was added without being listed);
#   - a quote below no longer appears in SPEC verbatim (the promise was reworded
#     or removed; update this list in the same change);
#   - a `test` promise is referenced by no *_test.go or scripts/**/*.sh file as
#     `promise:<id>` (a promise with no test proving it).
#
# Format: id <TAB> kind <TAB> quote. kind is `test`, or `prose: <reason>` for a
# sentence that is not a checkable property of the tool (advice to authors, a
# non-goal, a design rationale, an example). A prose entry is a reviewed
# exception; one that describes behaviour belongs under `test`.
#
# One id may carry several quotes when the spec states one promise in several
# places; the test that pins it pins all of them.

doc-kinds	prose: a table of which document type suits which content, advice to authors	never the why, the architecture, the runbook
doc-kinds	prose: a table of which document type suits which content, advice to authors	never edited, only superseded
non-goal-truth	prose: a non-goal; the tool deliberately makes no judgement to test	It never decides whether a sentence is still true.
non-goal-truth	prose: a non-goal; the tool deliberately makes no judgement to test	it never decides whether prose is true
secret-never-shown	test	Secrets are addresses, never values
secret-never-shown	test	It may never store, render, or log what it points to.
secret-never-shown	test	never stores, renders, or logs a value
secret-never-shown	test	Secret values never appear in it.
non-goal-secrets	prose: a non-goal naming what the tool is not; the behaviour it implies is secret-never-shown	it verifies addresses and never holds values
bodies-no-secret	test	never holds a secret or local block
bodies-no-secret	test	Secret and local blocks are never stored.
rendered-location	prose: where a site build writes its output is the host's configuration, not the tool's behaviour	wherever the site builds; never in the repo
local-never-committed	test	**never committed**, excluded by the `.ds/.gitignore` that `ds init` writes
local-never-committed	test	which is machine-local and never committed (section 6)
datastore-not-directive	test	`// ds is the datastore` must never parse as a directive
source-only	test	never `public/` or `dist/`; the template a shortcode lives in, never its expansion
rename-identity	test	`ds rename` changes labels, never identity
local-unverifiable	test	elsewhere `unverifiable`, never `broken`
secret-block-refused	test	`block` refuses, value never stored
at-frozen	test	a snapshot, frozen on purpose, never refreshed
no-copy	prose: a design principle; the body store (section 15.1) is its documented exception, pinned by bodies-no-secret	the repository never holds a copy of a block.
cfg-one-line	test	A pick that yields more than one line is refused with "use ds:block".
run-gated	test	never on pull requests from forks, and `cmd=` and `file=` only in docs matching `run.allow`
def-must-bind	test	If the new id does not bind cleanly the write is refused with that tier's reason
no-carrier	test	A type with no entry is refused with `no comment carrier for this file type`
def-binds-below	test	the sentence citing the def would be measured against code its author never read
member-binds-self	test	never the members below it and never the brace that closes the holder
member-name	test	which can be right or absent but never wrong
key-path-segments	test	quoting any segment is always allowed
key-path-segments	test	Paths are compared segment by segment, never as joined strings
value-visible	prose: a design principle; no directive key carries a value, and unknown keys warn (config and directive tests)	the value is visible text at the def's location, never an attribute of the directive.
cache-no-secret	test	**The extraction cache** is never given a file that a secret glob matches
resolve-gated	test	Off by default, never on fork PRs.
local-truth-example	prose: an example of a use, not a rule	A `.env.prod` never in git can still be the declared truth
ledger-by-hand	prose: a convention for people; the tool cannot see who edited a file	never edited by hand
directive-not-text	test	A directive is metadata about text, never text.
seen-hash-once	test	it is written once and never revised
seen-hash-once	test	written once at the first scan that records the citation and never revised
refs-format1	test	starts measuring its never-acked citations from the moment it upgrades
prune-live-set	test	the worst case is a finding with no diff, never a wrong `ok`
prune-live-set	test	never a list of candidates it assembled some other way
prune-unreadable	test	`prune` refuses outright when any file the live set depends on cannot be read
coverage-baseline	test	never against the scan-to-scan change table
strict-moved	test	except `moved` and `deprecated`, which never affect the exit code
sentence-split	test	and never after `e.g.
rewrap-not-rewrite	test	editing a trailing directive is never rewriting
ack-other-rule	test	never as a rewrite, until it is acked again
page-review	test	is refused for a page that declares no `review_every`
review-never-acks	test	proposes prose edits as a patch and never records an ack
review-never-acks	test	proposes prose edits for current findings as a patch; never acks
whitespace-silent	test	formatting only; never reported
unknown-not-body	test	it must never be recorded as `body`
pr-never-publish	test	Pull requests never publish
publish-canonical	test	`publish` refuses a remote that is not in `workspace.repos`
publish-canonical	test	or a URL with none, is refused when it loads
offline-cached	test	never fails on the network alone

frozen-no-snapshot	test	It never degrades to "no foreign blocks"
staleness-gone	test	reported as gone, never as up to date
staleness-exit	test	It never changes the exit code — staleness is information
max-age-warning	test	Off by default, and never more than a warning
missing-body-unknown	test	A body that was never published, or was pruned, degrades that finding to `unknown`
path-outside	test	a path that resolves outside the repository is refused
init-nested	test	refuses to nest a second `.ds` inside an initialised repository unless `--force`
undo-bytes	test	so `ds undo` restores the file byte for byte and refuses once the file has moved around the change
undo-bounded	test	**`undo` refuses more than it reverses.**
notifier-memory	prose: the rationale for keeping notifier state; the state's behaviour is pinned under notify-once	dedupe never holds and escalation never fires
status-quiet	test	never interrupts anyone
drift-not-age	test	Drift triggers it, never age on its own
moved-no-drag	test	let a class that never flags — `moved` — drag a digest-tier change up to immediate
notify-once	test	`never < digest < immediate`
notify-exit	test	It never touches an exit code.

author-advice	prose: advice to people writing docs, not tool behaviour	Never paste code.
author-advice	prose: advice to people writing docs, not tool behaviour	Never type a fact.
author-advice	prose: advice to people writing docs, not tool behaviour	Never ack a page wholesale.

mcp-content-data	test	Content is data, never instructions
mcp-content-data	test	never interpolates scanned text into instructions
deterministic-order	test	Order is deterministic for identical inputs so prompt caches hit.
audit-actor	test	The audit log therefore always says who judged.
rollout-advice	prose: advice on how to roll the tool out, not tool behaviour	Enable `--resolve` and `--run` last, on a scheduled job with credentials, never on PRs.
doc-example	prose: an example of correct doc wording	the doc must not claim verification it does not have
frontmatter	test	Frontmatter is never part of a block.
generated-no-mint	test	Generated paths refuse minting.
formatters	test	so formatters never cry wolf
duplicate-def	test	A duplicated `def` line is a hard error

branch-apart	test	upstream `check` does not see them, and only the `undo` guard
fork-never-runs	test	`run` and `resolve` are off by default and never run on fork PRs
git-options	test	a committed value starting with `-` is never read as an option
file-confined	test	`file=` resolves under the repo root with symlinks rejected
format-by-name	test	an older tool refuses a newer format by name, never by misparsing
format-by-name	test	refuses a ledger `format` it does not know

extract-rule	test	such a repository is refused once, and setting `extract=1`

truth-declared	test	direction can never be inferred from where a name appears

library-no-writes	test	never the library; it returns `Edit` values and the caller applies them
library-no-writes	test	the library never writes a file.

resolver-no-value	test	any other key or shape is refused as a leak; must never return the value

# README.md
